decisions.reason: After two years this core handle family would face somewhat tighter comparison with aspiration levels, but without clear signs of underperformance management would usually keep it and continue learning within normal portfolio slack.

The mitred handle family remains close to the firm's design-led core, yet if adoption has stayed merely ordinary rather than clearly strong the firm would raise scrutiny slightly while still preferring retention over immediate redeployment.

Because the multifunctional lever directly supports the firm's barrier-free and integrated-solution direction, management is likely to tolerate continued uncertainty unless results now plainly fall below comparable launches.

As another adjacent handle line without any reported standout signal, it is more exposed to comparison against internal aspirations and alternative uses of resources, though not enough to justify withdrawal absent negative evidence.

The collection's award-backed external validation and strong fit with the firm's architecture-oriented brand keep it comfortably above the threshold where problemistic search would trigger a withdrawal.
